messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 streaming latency breach detected in eu-central-1 (dedicated pool eu-ded-3). Queue depth spiking; streaming stalls reported. Paging @emily (oncall). Estimated affected tenants: ~11. Autoscale attempts: 2 (failed warmup handshake).
emily: oncall - I'm looking. Pulling traces and pool telemetry. can someone paste recent autoscale logs? :eyes:
raj: grabbing autoscaler logs now. early hints: warmup handshake not finishing, handshake RTTs show 30-40s spikes. KV-cache coldpath more frequent.
taylor: noticed burst at 18:02UTC that coincides with a marketing job from customer X. bursting small hotshot jobs into dedicated pool. queue depth jumped from 30->900 in <90s.
emily: customer impact? streaming stalls = clients see stalled event stream + reconnects?
lucy: support here. Confirmed 8 customers reported degraded streaming (timeouts + reconnects). One enterprise customer reported partial write failures. Logging shows `streaming_conn_reset` spikes.
maria: correlating support tickets -> request ids show p99 token latency ~12s elevated to 45s. p95 trending ~8s -> 20s.
ops-bot: autoscaler attempt #3 at 18:06 UTC: started scale +warmup, pool eu-ded-3 handshake timeout after 70s, aborted. Reason: node init time exceeded expected warmup window.
emily: ok — immediate mitigation options? suggestions: 1) emergency manual scale to a warm pool 2) reroute new streaming traffic to backup pool (eu-ded-1) 3) temporarily throttle hotshot queue.
raj: +1 reroute but be careful: model quantization variants on eu-ded-1 differ for some tenants. may cause quality regression. Prefer partial reroute for streaming-only endpoints.
taylor: I can flip routing rule for streaming traffic only. small config change: `rbctl routing update --pool eu-ded-3 --route-type streaming --fallback eu-ded-1` (dry-run first).
emily: do it. run dry-run then promote if green.
taylor: running dry-run now...
ops-bot: dry-run complete -> plan applies, no config conflicts.
taylor: promoting route change.
ops-bot: routing change applied at 18:12 UTC. ~35% of new streaming traffic now flows to eu-ded-1.
maria: support: we're still getting complaints from customers pinned to eu-ded-3 (no cross-region). Can we evict long-running hotshot jobs from eu-ded-3?
raj: can we do graceful eviction? propose drain of hotshot queue and force warmup for 2 extra replicas. Command: ```rbctl drain-pool --pool eu-ded-3 --selectors job_type=hotshot --grace 30s``` then ```rbctl scale pool eu-ded-3 --replicas 4 --extra-warmup 30s --force```
emily: approve manual drain + scale. who will run?
taylor: I'll run drain, raj can run scale override.
lucy: pinging affected account managers and marking incident on status page.
ops-bot: drain job submitted at 18:15 UTC. 120 hotshot tasks evicted and rerouted to overflow queue.
raj: initiating scale override now. Note: node images are being pulled, expect another ~40s warmup.
raj: scale command returned success but node warmup stuck at 50% -> underlying network to image registry showing intermittent 502s.
emily: ok fallback: spin up ephemeral warm nodes using pre-baked snapshot AMI. raj — can you trigger `rbctl scale --ami prewarmed-eu-2026-03-15`?
raj: running prewarmed AMI scale... started at 18:21 UTC. Nodes joined pool at 18:23 UTC. KV-cache priming in progress.
aylor: (typo)
emily: :thumbsup: good. monitoring p99 and queue depth.
maria: customers on eu-ded-3 reporting partial improvement; support volume decreasing.
taylor: (typo correction) taylor: p99 dropped from 48s -> 14s after reroute + scale. p95 down to ~9s. Still above normal but improving.
taylor: streaming stall rate dropped by ~70%.
lucy: leaving status page note: "Mitigation in progress. Some streaming traffic temporarily rerouted. Working on full recovery."
emily: next steps: 1) monitor for 30m, 2) let autoscaler stabilize with prewarmed AMI, 3) postmortem scheduled. who owns postmortem?
raj: runtime team will own root cause and kernel/warmup improvements. I'll take lead.
emily: ops postmortem owner for paging/runbook gaps: taylor.
taylor: ack. I'll take on-page runbook updates.
ops-bot: incident: #1839998000 status -> mitigation: routing/reroute + manual scale complete. Customer impact reduced.
emily: handing off to taylor for overnight watch. if p99 creeps >25s alert me.
taylor: taking watch. leaving notes: watch queue depth metric `ded.pool.eu-ded-3.queue_depth`, handshake RTT `ded.pool.eu-ded-3.handshake_rtt`, and autoscaler errors `autoscaler.warmup_failures`.
emily: great. thanks all. :heart:
lucy: creating support follow-ups to notify affected accounts and offer credits where applicable.
maria: collecting logs for postmortem. exporting traces to S3 -> s3://redwood-incident-archives/1839998000/
emily: closing active paging but keeping thread open for postmortem. last check-in at 18:28 UTC shows steady improvement.
ops-bot: Closing note: schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Participants: raj, taylor, emily, lucy, maria.
taylor: acknowledged. handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
